name: Clipboard Shelf
description:
Clipboard Shelf turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a touch-first shelf for recent Windows text clipboard history. Copy text anywhere in Windows and recent entries appear as readable cards with a clear current-copy indicator. Tap a card once to make it the active clipboard value again.

Pin snippets you never want normal history pruning to remove, mark favorites for quick filtering, recognize URLs at a glance, search on roomier XENEON layouts, delete individual entries, or clear the full history with a confirmation step. Long and multiline text wraps safely instead of shrinking into unreadable type.

Private Mode pauses new capture and hides existing clipboard text on the XENEON display until you resume. The configurable history size applies to unpinned entries, so important pinned snippets remain available.

Reliable continuous Windows clipboard history requires the free PackRat Clipboard Shelf Bridge for Windows. The engineering release kit includes the companion build so it can be distributed alongside the widget. The bridge runs only on this PC, listens only on loopback, stores clipboard state locally with Windows DPAPI protection, and never sends clipboard contents to PackRat servers, cloud sync, analytics, or CI logs.

Version 1 is intentionally text-first. Files and images are not included because reliable text history is more useful than a fragile oversized feature set.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.
release_notes:
• Readable recent Windows text clipboard cards with one-tap copy
• Pins, favorites, URL recognition, filters, and long-text handling
• Configurable local history with individual delete and clear-all confirmation
• Private Mode pauses capture and hides clipboard text on the display
• Eight tuned XENEON Edge layouts with automatic bridge reconnect
